title.en: AI Development for Workers AI Users: Bedrock

sources.title: Inference using Converse API
supports: Converse needs bedrock:InvokeModel; ConverseStream needs bedrock:InvokeModelWithResponseStream
Order of ConverseStream events: messageStart, content block events, messageStop (with stopReason), metadata (usage and metrics)
contentBlockStart is sent for tool use only; a text delta is {contentBlockDelta: {delta: {text}, contentBlockIndex}}
Shape of a Converse response: output.message.content[].text, stopReason, usage, metrics

sources.title: ConverseStream (API reference)
supports: Request fields modelId, messages, system, inferenceConfig.maxTokens
modelId accepts a base model ID or an inference profile ID
Stream members include internalServerException (500), modelStreamErrorException (424), serviceUnavailableException (503), throttlingException (429), validationException (400)

Errors: AccessDeniedException 403, ModelErrorException 424, ModelNotReadyException 429, ModelTimeoutException 408, ResourceNotFoundException 404, ServiceUnavailableException 503, ThrottlingException 429, ValidationException 400
The AWS CLI does not support ConverseStream

sources.title: MessageStopEvent (API reference)
supports: stopReason values: end_turn, tool_use, max_tokens, stop_sequence, guardrail_intervened, content_filtered, malformed_model_output, malformed_tool_use, model_context_window_exceeded

sources.title: Request access to models
supports: Access to many foundation models is enabled by default; there is no per-model request step in commercial Regions
The first invocation of a third-party model starts an AWS Marketplace subscription, which needs aws-marketplace:Subscribe, Unsubscribe, and ViewSubscriptions and can take up to 15 minutes
Anthropic models need a one-time use case form per account or organization before the first call
Amazon models are not sold through AWS Marketplace
After a model is enabled, callers no longer need the Marketplace permissions

sources.title: Route model inference requests across AWS Regions with cross-Region inference
supports: A geographic profile routes within a geography; a global profile routes to any commercial Region
No additional routing cost; the price is that of the Region the profile is called from
CloudTrail logs the request in the source Region with additionalEventData.inferenceRegion

sources.title: Supported Regions and models for inference profiles
supports: Profile IDs and destination Regions are documented on each model's card
GetInferenceProfile lists the destination Regions of a profile as seen from one source Region
Do not infer the destinations from the geographic prefix of the profile ID alone

sources.title: Prerequisites for inference profiles
supports: A policy that names an inference profile must also name the foundation model in each Region associated with it
The bedrock:InferenceProfileArn condition key limits a foundation-model statement to calls made through one profile
The example for a global profile names the model in the source Region and with an empty Region

sources.title: Model card: Amazon Nova 2 Lite
supports: Model ID amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0; profiles jp.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0 and global.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0
From ap-northeast-1 the model is offered through Geo and Global profiles, not In-Region
jp.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0 called from ap-northeast-1 routes to ap-northeast-1 and ap-northeast-3
Supports Converse and response streaming; max output 64K tokens

sources.title: Model card: Anthropic Claude Haiku 4.5
supports: On bedrock-runtime the model needs a geo or global inference profile ID; the bare model ID is not supported for on-demand use
jp.anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0 called from ap-northeast-1 routes to ap-northeast-1 and ap-northeast-3
Billed through AWS Marketplace; EOL no sooner than 2026-10-16

sources.title: Troubleshooting Amazon Bedrock API Error Codes
supports: ThrottlingException (429) means the account quota was exceeded; retry with exponential backoff and jitter, or request a quota increase
ServiceUnavailable (503) is capacity, not the account quota
A missing Anthropic use case form answers 404

sources.title: Quotas for Amazon Bedrock
supports: Model inference is controlled by per-model quotas on token usage
The quotas that apply to an account can be lower than the published defaults; Service Quotas shows the applied values

sources.title: Response streaming for Lambda functions
supports: Streaming is available through function URLs, InvokeWithResponseStream, and API Gateway proxy integrations
A streamed response is not interrupted when the client disconnects, and the full function duration is billed
Node.js managed runtimes support response streaming natively
Streamed payloads can be up to 200 MB; the first 6 MB is not rate limited
Function URLs do not support response streaming for a function in a VPC

sources.title: Writing response streaming-enabled Lambda functions
supports: A streaming handler is wrapped in awslambda.streamifyResponse, a global the Node.js runtime on Lambda provides

sources.title: Control access to Lambda function URLs
supports: AuthType is AWS_IAM or NONE
With AWS_IAM, a caller in the same account needs lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl and lambda:InvokeFunction in an identity policy or in the function's resource-based policy
With NONE, anyone with the URL can invoke the function once the resource-based policy grants public access

sources.title: Stream the integration response for your proxy integrations in API Gateway
supports: Response streaming is supported for REST APIs only, with responseTransferMode STREAM on proxy integrations
Streams run up to 15 minutes; idle timeout is 5 minutes for Regional endpoints
The Lambda function may keep running after the connection closes

sources.title: Restrict access to an AWS Lambda function URL origin
supports: CloudFront origin access control signs requests to a function URL whose AuthType is AWS_IAM
For POST and PUT the client must send the SHA-256 of the body in x-amz-content-sha256

sources.title: AWS Lambda pricing (response streaming)
supports: The first 6 MB streamed per request is free
The page lists no separate charge for function URLs
sources.note: Same page as lambda-pricing, re-read for chapter 17.

sources.title: AWS Price List: Amazon Bedrock, ap-northeast-1
supports: Nova 2.0 Lite in Tokyo: USD 0.000396 per 1K input tokens, USD 0.003311 per 1K output tokens
Nova 2.0 Lite through the global profile from Tokyo: USD 0.00036 and USD 0.00301 per 1K tokens
sources.note: The offer has a plain row and a `cross-region-global` row. It has no row named for the jp. profile; the chapter applies the plain row to it, following the user guide's statement that the price is that of the calling Region.

sources.title: AWS Price List: Amazon Bedrock foundation models (Marketplace), ap-northeast-1
supports: Claude Haiku 4.5 in Tokyo, Regional: USD 1.10 per 1M input tokens, USD 5.50 per 1M output tokens

sources.title: Cloudflare Workers AI: Get started
supports: Workers AI always accesses your Cloudflare account to run models and incurs usage charges even in local development
A Worker calls a model as env.AI.run("@cf/...", {...})

sources.title: Cloudflare Workers AI: Bindings
supports: The AI binding is declared in the wrangler configuration and called as env.AI.run(model, options)
`stream: true` returns results as a text/event-stream
sources.note: This page says nothing about local development or charges; that claim rests on cloudflare-workers-ai-quickstart and cloudflare-bindings-per-env.

sources.title: Cloudflare Workers: Supported bindings per development mode
supports: The AI binding has no local simulation; it connects to the remote service during local development

sources.title: Cloudflare Workers AI: Pricing
supports: Billing unit is Neurons: 10,000 per day free, then USD 0.011 per 1,000 Neurons on the Workers Paid plan
LLM prices are also listed per million input and output tokens for each model

sources.title: hono 4.13.13 (published package)
supports: hono/aws-lambda exports streamHandle, which wraps the app in awslambda.streamifyResponse
streamHandle does not cancel the response body when writing to the Lambda response stream fails, so stream.onAbort does not fire there
hono/aws-lambda is marked deprecated in favor of @hono/aws-lambda for v5
streamSSE calls stream.onAbort listeners when the response body is cancelled
sources.note: Read from dist/adapter/aws-lambda/handler.js, dist/helper/streaming/sse.js, and dist/utils/stream.js of the installed package. Not run on Lambda.

sources.title: @aws-sdk/client-bedrock-runtime 3.1149.0 (published package)
supports: ConverseStreamCommand returns `stream`, an async iterable of ConverseStreamOutput
An exception message in the event stream is thrown by the iterator as an error named after the exception
The default retry strategy makes up to 3 attempts
sources.note: Read from the type definitions and from @smithy/core 3.35.2 (event-streams getUnmarshalledStream.js, DEFAULT_MAX_ATTEMPTS) in the installed packages. No request was sent.

definition.ja: Bedrock が API として提供する学習済みのモデル。モデル ID で指定する。
definition.en: A pretrained model that Bedrock offers behind an API, selected by its model ID.

definition.ja: モデルが文章を読み書きする単位で、課金の単位でもある。文字数とは一致せず、数え方はモデルごとに違う。
definition.en: The unit in which a model reads and writes text, and the unit it is billed in. It is not a character count, and each model counts differently.

definition.ja: モデルと、リクエストを送ってよいリージョンの組に付いた ID。モデル ID の代わりに指定する。
definition.en: An ID for a model together with the Regions a request may be sent to. It is passed in place of a model ID.

definition.ja: inference profile を通して、呼び出したリージョンとは別のリージョンで推論が処理され得る仕組み。
definition.en: Inference that, through an inference profile, may be processed in a Region other than the one you called.

definition.ja: Lambda が応答を最後まで溜めずに、できた分から呼び出し元へ送る方式。
definition.en: A Lambda function sending its response piece by piece as it is produced, instead of buffering all of it.

definition.ja: Lambda 関数に直接付く HTTPS の endpoint。API Gateway を挟まない。
definition.en: An HTTPS endpoint attached directly to a Lambda function, with no API Gateway in between.

definition.ja: 1 つの HTTP 応答の中で、サーバーがイベントを順に送り続ける形式。content type は text/event-stream。
definition.en: A format in which a server keeps sending events inside one HTTP response. Its content type is text/event-stream.

definition.ja: AWS の API が呼び出し元を確かめるためのリクエスト署名。認証情報から計算して header に付ける。
definition.en: The request signature AWS APIs use to identify the caller, computed from credentials and sent in headers.

summary.ja: 17章は実際の Bedrock を一度も呼んでいない。モデル ID（jp.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0 など）が東京から呼べること、実際の ConverseStream のイベントが src/converse-stream.ts の schema に合うこと、fixture の形が実物と一致することは未確認。
summary.en: Chapter 17 has never called real Bedrock. That the model IDs (such as jp.amazon.nova-2-lite-v1:0) can be called from Tokyo, that real ConverseStream events fit the schema in src/converse-stream.ts, and that the fixtures match the real shapes are all unconfirmed.

resume.ja: examples/17-ai/.env を用意して vp run ai:hello、続けて vp run ai:test:live を実行する（課金される）。イベントの形が違えば schema と fixture を直す。
resume.en: Prepare examples/17-ai/.env, run vp run ai:hello and then vp run ai:test:live (billed). If the event shapes differ, fix the schema and the fixtures.

summary.ja: 17章の stack はデプロイしていない。Hono の streamHandle と streamSSE が Node.js 24 の Lambda で function URL（RESPONSE_STREAM、AWS_IAM）を通して少しずつ届くこと、streamSSE が付ける Transfer-Encoding などの header を Lambda が受け付けること、署名なしのリクエストが 403 になること、inference profile に絞った IAM policy で ConverseStream が通ること、cdkd が AWS::Lambda::Url の InvokeMode を反映することは未確認。
summary.en: The chapter 17 stack has not been deployed. Unconfirmed: that Hono's streamHandle and streamSSE deliver the response piece by piece on the Node.js 24 Lambda runtime through a function URL (RESPONSE_STREAM, AWS_IAM); that Lambda accepts the headers streamSSE sets, such as Transfer-Encoding; that an unsigned request answers 403; that ConverseStream passes with the IAM policy scoped to the inference profile; and that cdkd applies InvokeMode on AWS::Lambda::Url.

resume.ja: vp run ai:infra:deploy、vp run ai:smoke（delta の到着時刻が表示される）、vp run ai:logs、vp run ai:infra:drift、vp run ai:infra:destroy の順に実行する。
resume.en: Run vp run ai:infra:deploy, vp run ai:smoke (it prints when each delta arrived), vp run ai:logs, vp run ai:infra:drift, and vp run ai:infra:destroy, in that order.

summary.ja: 途中で中断した ConverseStream に、どこまでの token が課金されるかを一次情報で確認できていない。Bedrock の無料枠、東京リージョンでの quota の値も未確認。
summary.en: How many tokens are billed for a ConverseStream call that is aborted midway was not confirmed from a primary source. Neither were a free allowance for Bedrock or the quota values in the Tokyo Region.

resume.ja: Bedrock の料金ページと Service Quotas を確認する。中断時の課金は、ai:test:live を途中で止めて請求と CloudWatch の metrics を見比べる。
resume.en: Check the Bedrock pricing page and Service Quotas. For aborted calls, stop ai:test:live midway and compare the bill with the CloudWatch metrics.
